source: DHM Islamic Level 1 · lesson 14 «How We Pray» (11 steps). Sacred sayings are flagged and their audio waits for Dr. Hassan's review.
topic: Step 8–9: standing for the next rak‘ah, and the tashahhud sitting

words.en: and all prayers and good things.

words.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ،
words.en: Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings.

words.ar: السَّلَامُ عَلَيْنَا وَعَلَى عِبَادِ اللهِ الصَّالِحِينَ،
words.en: Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah.

words.ar: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ،
words.en: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah,
and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.

quiz.en: How do we stand up for the next rak‘ah?
What do we raise in the tashahhud?
After the middle tashahhud (e.g. in Dhuhr)…
opts: we stand up for the next rak‘ah

move.en: Sit for the tashahhud like Koko: left foot down, right foot up, and raise your index finger.

parents.summary: Standing for the next rak‘ah with Allahu Akbar, and the tashahhud — learned phrase by phrase with an ordering game.
parents.tip: Learn one line of the tashahhud a day together; he can say it to you before bed.
